From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap and mutual action timeline — Strata Analytics

Thanks again for taking time today — good conversation. Below is a concise recap of the pain, goals, and a proposed Mutual Action Timeline to keep momentum. Please flag anything missing or wrong and confirm owners for each milestone.

What we heard (pain + impact)
- Model drift + label latency: internal models take 3–4 weeks to retrain; prediction quality degrades during seasonal spikes.
- High per-inference cost at scale (inference spend doubled last quarter).
- Engineering time tied up maintaining inference infra vs. product work.

Short-term goals (90 days)
- Run a 6-week pilot for the customer support reranking pipeline (100k monthly queries) to measure latency and cost delta.
- Achieve 2x throughput improvement and >25% reduction in per-token cost vs. current baseline.
- Validate rollback and canary behavior for safety-critical prompts.

Proposed Mutual Action Timeline (draft)
1) Pilot kickoff prep (Dec 6 — Dec 13) — Confirm data access, sample queries, and SOC2 questionnaire intake. Owner: Evan Park
2) Integration & test (Dec 14 — Dec 30) — Redwood provides integration guide + sandbox cluster; Strata runs smoke tests. Owner: Lydia James
3) Pilot run (Jan 3 — Feb 14) — 6 weeks live traffic subset; weekly syncs. Owner: Evan + Redwood engineering lead
4) Eval & decision (Feb 17 — Feb 24) — technical readout, cost analysis, exec sponsor review. Owner: Strata execs / procurement

Immediate asks from Redwood
- Confirm pilot stakeholders (engineering, security, procurement).
- Provide a preferred procurement contact and any draft SOW constraints.
- Fill the attached quick security checklist if possible (we'll feed answers into your vendor intake).

Attachments: Strata_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (timeline + milestones), pilot-scope-onepager.pdf, redwood-security-quicksheet.pdf

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm owners and availability for kickoff the week of Dec 6.
- We'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with engineering and security to enable sandbox access.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this pilot.

Best,
Hannah

Thanks, Hannah — this is helpful and aligns with our notes. Quick confirmations and tweaks: 

1) Stakeholders:
- Engineering (owner): Lydia James (already looped)
- Security point: Priya Menon (procurement sec intake) — I've cc'd her in the metadata list below and will formally add to the kickoff invite.
- Exec sponsor: Rajesh Iyer (VP Product) — will attend the final decision readout.

2) Timeline: Dec 6 kickoff OK, but can we shift the integration window to Dec 16–31? Lydia's team is focused on a release this week and prefers a later integration start.

3) Procurement/Commercial: We need a ballpark pricing range for the pilot (estimate of monthly spend given 100k queries) to take to procurement. Also please confirm what data handling options are available for PII redaction during the pilot.

4) Security questionnaire: we'll start with your quicksheet. Priya, can you take a look and let Hannah know if you need SOC2 evidence or specific encryption docs?

If Redwood can provide a short (1–2 slide) cost estimate and a note on PII handling before EOD Thursday, that would help speed procurement.

Thanks — Evan

Hi all — quick update after internal sync with Ben and Marissa. We incorporated Lydia's timeline preference and updated the attached MAP (v1.1). Key changes and confirmations below: 

- Integration window moved to Dec 16 — Dec 31. Kickoff meeting set for Dec 16 at 11:00 AM PT (I'll send the invite once Evan confirms).
- Pilot run dates remain Jan 3 — Feb 14 (6 weeks).
- Redwood will provide: sandbox cluster, integration playbook, weekly runbook checks, and a lightweight telemetry dashboard.
- Data handling options for pilot: (a) token-level hashing for identifiable fields, (b) client-side PII redaction guidance + example scripts, (c) option to route sensitive fields to a private VPC instance for processing. See attached 'redwood-security-quicksheet.pdf' for details.
- Commercial/back-of-envelope: estimated pilot spend range $6k–$12k/mo depending on batching and effective tokens/query. Marissa will attach a 1-slide estimate.

Action items and owners
- Evan: confirm kickoff invite and add Priya to procurement thread.
- Priya: let us know whether SOC2 evidence or additional certs are needed for vendor intake.
- Ben / Marissa: finalize 1-slide cost note + draft SOW (Marissa will share SOW v0.1). Due EOD Dec 3.

Links and artifacts:
